digest.component_or_area: CLI mutation verbs and output handling
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) currently exit 0 with empty stdout on success, making successful writes indistinguishable from idempotent no-ops and causing agents to issue unnecessary follow-up store reads to verify their own writes.

The confirmation output must follow a uniform kubectl-style contract: one stdout line per invocation in past-tense verb form (e.g. 'linked src -> target (relation)', 'no change: already linked src -> target (relation)'), built only from CLI args and seam outcome without follow-up store reads.

Global output flags (--quiet/-q to suppress confirmations, --output/-o to select json format) must be extracted once at the top-level router before partition dispatch so that positional-only _REGISTRY leaf verbs gain uniform output control without changing their argument parsing.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must be normalized to the shared confirmation contract preserving every datum from their old output (e.g. transition's UNBLOCKED ids), with zero information loss verified by test.

The link verb's REDIRECT record (existing machine-readable JSON output) must remain byte-identical before/after and must be preserved under --quiet, with confirmations printing only in text mode and no mixed text+JSON on one invocation.

Consumed seam return types (e.g. add_dependency's dict | None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged; outcome signals are added only as a parallel channel when the existing return cannot distinguish wrote-vs-noop.
